description: Known divergences of the Go Tokenizer component from the Python DSL path (rag/flow/tokenizer/tokenizer.py). Items tagged go_intentional are Go-correct behaviors that MUST NOT be 'aligned' to the DSL; they are pinned by no-tag unit tests. Items tagged go_bug are Go defects to fix. Absence of an entry means the two paths are expected to match.

diffs.reason: When the upstream document name is empty, Go skips title weighting so the merged vector is the content vector alone. From the end-user perspective an empty title must not contribute the filename embedding weight; the Python DSL instead computes 0.1*emb(""), injecting an undefined bias into every chunk. Go's skip is correct.

Each dataset configures its own embedding model. An empty kb_id (e.g. a canvas-debug dry run) must NOT fall back to the tenant's default embedding model, otherwise the produced vectors cannot be used at retrieval time for that dataset. The kbID != "" guard is deliberate.
